spec.calendar: union of all trading dates; a market with no bar on a date has return 0 that day and keeps its position
spec.returns: close-to-close simple return; if price <= 0 or |r| > 6 x trailing 60-day std of that market, r := 0 (continuous-contract roll artefacts, negative oil)
spec.proxyNote: TWII price index stands in for TX futures; TSMC/MEDIATEK stock prices stand in for their stock futures; Yahoo =F series are unadjusted front-month splices
spec.vol: sigma_i = std of the last 60 daily returns x sqrt(252)
spec.signalA_primary: time-series momentum: s = sign(sum of the last 252 daily returns)
spec.signalB_secondary: Donchian: long after close > highest close of prior 100 days, short after close < lowest of prior 100; exit long when close < lowest close of prior 50, exit short when close > highest of prior 50
spec.sizing: w_i = s_i x (0.10 / sigma_i) / N_active (N_active = markets with a valid signal that day)
spec.rebalance: positions recomputed every 5th calendar-union business day from closes; applied from the NEXT day return (1-day lag)
spec.benchmark: TX-only: the same rule and sizing on TWII alone (w = s x 0.10/sigma)
spec.primary: portfolio net annualised Sharpe over the full period; one-sided p from 5000 calendar-year block bootstrap draws (share of draws with Sharpe <= 0); pass if p < 0.05
secondary: portfolio Sharpe minus TX-only Sharpe (same bootstrap)
correlation of portfolio daily returns with TWII buy-and-hold

note: Rules are textbook parameters (12-month TSMOM; 100/50 Donchian), chosen before reading any outcome on these markets. Data never used before in this project except TWII.
